description: Use this when you need valid tag slugs for search_recipes, for example to filter by cuisine, course, diet or occasion. Without arguments returns every category with its tags; with category returns only that category's tags. Not needed for plain keyword searches. Without a linked account, the full list covers the featured categories and only tags that have public recipes.

category.description: A category slug or id, e.g. 'cuisine' or 'diet'. Leave out to get all categories.

name: get_filters
title: Get search filters
